description: The update decision (plans/P3-01.md §2.8; WIRE-CONTRACT-V4 §11, client behaviour outside the wire contract). `versionCases` pin `compareVersions(scheme, a, b)` (null when either side does not parse); `capabilityCases` pin `effectiveCapabilities(kind, {platform, subkind, server})`; `outletCases` pin `resolveUpdateOutlet({host, stamp, detected})` (a host value that is invalid raises `invalid-options`, so none is listed); `bucketVectors` pin `rolloutBucket(salt, installId)`, the first four bytes of SHA-256(UTF-8(salt) ‖ UTF-8(installId)) read big-endian, mod 10000; each row's `input` is a complete `UpdateDecisionInput` with the decoded feed and record, and `expect` is the `decideUpdate` decision, compared by value, and its `bootDecision`. The generator recomputes every case and row with its own reference implementation. A runner also asserts its compiled tables against `outlet-matrix.json`.
